# firstboot_dns_record (Resource)

One record inside a `firstboot_dns_zone`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The record's value. Changed in place.
- `name` (String) A relative label, `@` for the apex, or a fully qualified name inside the zone. The API's update cannot change it, so a change replaces the record.
- `type` (String) `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `NS`, `SRV` or `CAA`.
- `zone_id` (String) The zone this record belongs to.

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Required for `MX` and `SRV`, 0 to 65535. Ignored otherwise.
- `ttl` (Number) Seconds, 60 to 604800.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
